image_description: Two baby bibs lying flat on a textured beige fabric surface. The top bib is light mint green with a rounded neck opening, featuring three small square patch pockets with plaid patterns and button details. The bottom bib is larger, made of multi-colored plaid fabric (red, green, yellow, blue) with white lace trim along the edges. Both appear to be fabric-based with visible stitching.
